snippet: The āṇava rung: multiply taught, it works by entering the gaps between its own forms and resting in the near-kindred station — ascent by deepening, not by adding.
text: yad etad bahudha proktam anavam sivataptaye this anava taught manifoldly aims at siva hood the lowest rung is already teleologically complete tatrantar antaravisya entering into the intervals therein the practice is penetration between antar antara the manifold forms not piling more on visramyet savidhe pade rest in the proximate station the optative commands settling and savidha carries both nearness and kindredness the resting place is already of the goal s kind the anava rung multiply taught it works by entering the gaps between its own forms and resting in the near kindred station ascent by deepening not by adding how does the lowest means already contain the end

snippet: The ladder law: resort by abandonment, rung by rung, each distinct — the mechanism that makes the final means-lessness (v3) a completion rather than a refusal.
text: tato py anava samtyagat saktim bhumim upasrayet by abandoning even the anava each rung is climbed by leaving it api concedes even this lowest hold tato pi sambhavim evam then likewise the sambhava the same abandon and resort motion repeats upward taratamya kramat sphutam in graded sequence distinctly the rungs stay distinct sphutam no blurring of means the ladder law resort by abandonment rung by rung each distinct the mechanism that makes the final means lessness v3 a completion rather than a refusal what moves the yogi from rung to rung

snippet: The crown: ladder-ripened awakening fills the Bhairava expanse, means fall away, and entry into one's own self is entry into the all-containing — liberation as recognition, not acquisition.
text: kramodita vibodha mahamarici sampurita prasara bhairava bhava bhagi partaking of the bhairava state whose expanse is filled with the great rays of sequentially arisen awakening the climbed ladder s fruit in one compound ante bhyupaya nirapeksataya eva in the end with utter independence from means the anupaya moment tantrasara 1 caturvidham tal ch2 gatopaya nityam svatmanam avisati garbhitavisvarupam enters forever one s own self universe wombed the self entered already contains the all the crown ladder ripened awakening fills the bhairava expanse means fall away and entry into one s own self is entry into the all containing liberation as recognition not acquisition what happens when the ladder is complete

snippet: The seal: the finale — and with it the 37-ahnika work — is handed over as received teaching, its authority placed beyond the author.
text: kathito yam svasvarupapravesah this entry has been told passive perfective doctrine received and now delivered paramesthina by the supreme one agency placed above the author see uncertainties the seal the finale and with it the 37 ahnika work is handed over as received teaching its authority placed beyond the author on whose authority does the whole tantraloka close
